purpose: Consolidate bounded production-workflow evidence before further solver development.

policy.recipes: Existing validation recipes, unchanged; full default profiles; feasible_width_steps disabled.
policy.budgets: Existing per-stage iteration/evaluation/rejection budgets; no additional polish or retries after a failed gate.
policy.workers: Native validation defaults; Rowles explicitly one worker; same settings in both builds.
policy.acceptance: Preserve each case's existing scientific gates. Record termination independently; passing a bounded recipe is not full convergence.
policy.freshness: Rowles, Echidna and nickel are transfer checks not used in this QARR optimization campaign. All are previously registered project data, not pristine project-wide holdouts.
policy.timing: One discarded warmup and two measurements per build/case, alternating build order in persistent subprocesses; no concurrent campaign fits.
policy.promotion: No promotion based only on lower Rwp or test counts. Require physical validity, relevant scientific accuracy, transparent stops, repeatability and acceptable bounded-workflow cost across the panel.
policy.stop_rule: Complete this panel once without retuning. Keep failures and unavailable diagnostics. Park feasible-width development pending a reproducible practical failure or broader benefit.

cases.role: known failing bounded recipe; no longer an untouched holdout
CW neutron smoke coverage; not general structural accuracy
